Author: MathDad
Name: Senpan Admin Companion
Description: Serves as an alternative to many of the web-interface functions, allowing staff to operate various systems from within the game.
Punchline: Allows Senpan Tea House staff to use various app services right from the game.
Changelog: Adds an Owner column to the Tea Rooms table showing the character who owns each room, and fixes accented characters (e.g. the o-with-macron in a room name) that the game font lacks by merging Noto Sans CJK so they render across the window.
